summary: Fixed 6×16 0-bg grid with 2-4 COLORED 2-CELL VERTICAL COMPONENTS placed at FIXED COLUMN STARTS [1, 5, 9, 13] (one component per slot, separated by 4 columns). For EACH component i: pick a random row r ∈ {1..3}; paint cells (r, starts[i]) and (r+1, starts[i]) in a DISTINCT non-{0, 5} color drawn from {1..9}; with 50% probability ALSO paint cell (r+1, starts[i]+1) with COLOR 5 (a GRAY MARKER cell, signaling this component to be recolored). Other cells stay bg-0. Rule (GRAY MARKERS INHERIT NEAREST COLOR, COMPONENTS PACKED INTO 3-ROW STRIP): for EACH GRAY (color 5) MARKER cell: find the NEAREST non-gray non-bg cell (its color C) — typically the adjacent component. RECOLOR the gray cell to C (so the gray inherits its nearest color, extending the component). Then extract every now-uniform-color component and PACK them into a 3-ROW OUTPUT STRIP (specifically, place each component's crop into a tight 3-row arrangement, preserving color, in order). Net: gray markers absorb into their neighbors and the colored components are gathered into a compact 3-row gallery.

variants.written_solution: recolor gray(5) joiners to nearest colored component, then pack component shapes left-to-right
variants.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define colored
               (filter (lambda (cell) (let ((v (third cell))) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 5))))
                       (grid-cells g)))
             (define markers (find-color g 5))
             (define recolored
               (reduce (lambda (acc p)
                         (let* ((r (first p))
                                (c (second p))
                                (best (first (sort-by colored
                                                      (lambda (cell)
                                                        (+ (* 100
                                                              (+ (abs (- (first cell) r))
                                                                 (abs (- (second cell)
                                                                         c))))
                                                           (* 10 (first cell))
                                                           (second cell)))))))
                           (set-cell acc r c (third best))))
                       g
                       markers))
             (define comps
               (sort (objects recolored 0)
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (let ((ca (obj-c1 a))
                             (cb (obj-c1 b)))
                         (or (< ca cb) (and (= ca cb) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))))))
             (define out-w (for/sum ((o comps)) (obj-w o)))
             (define baseline
               (if (and (not (empty? comps)) (> (obj-r1 (first comps)) 0)) 1 0))
             (let pack
                  ((remaining comps) (x 0)
                    (after-tall #f)
                    (out (build-grid 3 out-w (r c) 0)))
                  (if (empty? remaining)
                      out
                      (let* ((o (first remaining))
                             (r1 (obj-r1 o))
                             (c1 (obj-c1 o))
                             (height (obj-h o))
                             (width (obj-w o))
                             (top (if (= height 1)
                                      (if (zero? r1) 2 1)
                                      (if after-tall 1 baseline)))
                             (painted (reduce (lambda (acc cell)
                                                (set-cell acc
                                                          (+ top (- (first cell) r1))
                                                          (+ x (- (second cell) c1))
                                                          (obj-color o)))
                                              out
                                              (obj-cells o))))
                        (pack (rest remaining)
                              (+ x width)
                              (or after-tall (>= height 3))
                              painted))))))))
